purpose: Fresh pre-registered holdout on an earlier, non-overlapping 2024 window. Registered before any 2024 data was fetched or any result observed. No parameter is tuned on the previous 2025-11 to 2026-11 sample.

data.note: Non-overlapping with the 2025-11-27 to 2026-11-25 development sample. SOL excluded until BTC/ETH admission passes.

decision_rule: promote_candidate only if accepted_for_paper_candidate is true; paper ledger still requires separate BOS approval. Criteria are identical to registry v1 and must not be relaxed.

experiments.hypothesis: If the trend+momentum family has a real out-of-sample edge, it should produce a majority of positive walk-forward folds on an independent 2024 window using the same fixed grid as exp-02; otherwise the earlier rejection was not sample-specific.

If the regime-aware pullback family generalises, the same fixed grid as exp-04 should satisfy unchanged validation-v1 on an independent 2024 window; otherwise its earlier positive OOS net was sample-specific.
